headline: The sentence in your head in the pediatrician's waiting room
body:
~~They're going to think I'm doing it wrong.~~
_They see a hundred parents a week. I'm the one who noticed._

~~I should already know the answer to this.~~
_Nobody knows the answer to a question they've never been asked._

~~I'm probably overreacting.~~
_I'm paying attention. That's the job._

~~Everyone else here has it together.~~
_Everyone else is also holding a baby and a list on their phone._
